description: This file contains a test script for Git, specifically testing the behavior of 'git branch --track'. It defines setup routines, test cases for creating tracking branches, handling of extra path arguments, overriding auto-setup configurations, and various configurations of branch tracking.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified contents, used for setting up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a series of commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail, asserting failure conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches command output for a pattern, used here to verify error messages.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets Git configuration variables for the test environment.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares specified Git configuration variables to ensure they have expected values.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, performs cleanup if necessary.
